rows.grounds: refers to the pair of positions under consideration
emphatic particle extending the negation to both members
demonstrative pointing to the two positions previously stated
doctrinal views or sides in the argument
negated verb expressing failure to be established; na + upapadyate

items.question: Can logical reasoning conclusively establish either of the two proposed doctrinal positions?
premises: Two doctrinal positions regarding the world's identity have been presented.
Each position seeks support through logical reasoning.
Logical reasoning fails to establish either of these positions.
items.inference: Neither of the two proposed positions is validated by reasoning.
uncertainties: The specific content of the two positions is supplied by the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: Even for these two positions, the reasoning does not hold.
